description: This file defines the Backbone.js view 'AppView' for a TodoMVC application, managing UI interactions, rendering, and collection event bindings.

classes.name: app.AppView
classes.description: Top-level Backbone View managing the TodoMVC app UI, including rendering, event handling, and collection interactions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up DOM element references, binds collection events, and fetches initial data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI based on the current state of the Todo collection.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Creates and appends a view for a single Todo item.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all Todo items to the list.

methods.name: filterOne
methods.description: Triggers visibility update for a single Todo.

methods.name: filterAll
methods.description: Applies filtering to all Todo items.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Generates attributes for a new Todo item.

methods.name: createOnEnter
methods.description: Creates a new Todo when Enter key is pressed.

methods.name: toggleAllComplete
methods.description: Sets all Todo items as completed or not based on the toggle.
